entries.title: Psalms 42:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of the sons of Korah.>> As the deer pants for the water brooks, So pants my soul for You, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 42:2
segments: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

entries.title: Psalms 42:3
segments: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say to me, "Where [is] your God?"

entries.title: Psalms 42:4
segments: When I remember these [things], I pour out my soul within me. For I used to go with the multitude; I went with them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, With a multitude that kept a pilgrim feast.

entries.title: Psalms 42:5
segments: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And [why] are you disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him [For] the help of His countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 42:6
segments: ¶O my God, my soul is cast down within me; Therefore I will remember You from the land of the Jordan, And from the heights of Hermon, From the Hill Mizar.

entries.title: Psalms 42:7
segments: Deep calls unto deep at the noise of Your waterfalls; All Your waves and billows have gone over me.

entries.title: Psalms 42:8
segments: The LORD will command His lovingkindness in the daytime, And in the night His song [shall be] with me-A prayer to the God of my life.

entries.title: Psalms 42:9
segments: I will say to God my Rock, "Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

entries.title: Psalms 42:10
segments: [As] with a breaking of my bones, My enemies reproach me, While they say to me all day long, "Where [is] your God?"

entries.title: Psalms 42:11
segments: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.
